violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) in the 2DR upright in the kitchen, Raw beef was observed being stored above a pot of beef soup
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW BEEF TO THE BOTTOM SHELF. PIC PUT THE SOUP ON THE SOUP TO REHEAT.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) elote soup was observed at 111f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REHEAT THE SOUP TO 165f. STAFF REHEATED THE SOUP TO 198f.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: TWO DOOR PREP TOP: CUT CABBAGE AT 55F, COOKED CORN AT 50F, CUT TOMATO AT 45F, TOMATO SALSA AT 50F. COOLER WAS OPERATING AT 50F. OPENED COMMERCIAL MAYO ON DRY STORAGE SHELF AT 65F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS ITEMS IN COOLER DISPOSED OF. OPENED COMMERCIAL MAYO DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEE REACHING INTO PREP-TOP WITH BAREHANDS AND PULLING A CHUNK OF RTE WHITE CHEESE OUT OF THE RTE TOMATO SALSA.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. CDI: FOOD EMPLOYEE RE-EDUCATED. CHEESE THROWN AWAY.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean POTS AND PANS were stored in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination. OBSERVED CLEAN POTS AND PANS STORED ON THE FLOOR NEXT TO THE MOP SINK - EXPOSING IT TO SPLASH.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. ITEMS MUST BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED BEFORE USE. PLEASE FIND A DIFFERENT PLACE TO STORE ITEMS AWAY FROM CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the kitchen being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED EQUIPMENT.
